text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I changed only files in `catalog/` and left the tests alone.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days late. It now multiplies the two.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of a slice off-by-one. It now returns exactly `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the third title. I added `Emma` by Austen, 1815, 1 copy. The author, year and copy count were my guess, since the tests only check the title.
